# Algolia — Algolia Startup Program

$10,000 in Algolia credit usable within the first 12 months after approval, for new or free-tier accounts only; unused credit lapses and accounts move to pay-as-you-go once the credit is spent.

| **Status** | Open - apply directly |

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $10,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | All the unused credits will expire/lapse after 12 months. |
| **When it ends** | The moment your $10,000 credits are exhausted, you will be automatically moved to Pay as you go plan. |


### Not covered

- Existing paying Algolia customers
- Anyone who has previously used another Algolia coupon code

> **Stacking:** "Can I redeem more than one code?" is answered "No, if you have used any other coupon code in the past, you will not be eligible for the Algolia Startup Program." Credits are also stated to be non-transferable.

### Notes

VENDOR SELF-CONTRADICTION on the same page. The marketing eligibility bullets read "Less than 7 years old", "Less than $15M in total funding raised", "For new Algolia customers only". The FAQ answer to "Who is eligible for the Algolia startup program?" reads "Startups that are less than three years old and have raised less than $5M in funding are eligible for the program." I have recorded the more conservative FAQ figures (3 years, $5M) in company_age_max_years and funding_max_usd; an applicant between those two sets of limits should confirm with Algolia. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
